tinker.name: Browser
tinker.description: Web browser with multi-tab support and search integration

zh-CN.name: 浏览器
zh-CN.description: 网页浏览器，支持多标签页和搜索

list_tabs.description: List open browser tabs with id, title, URL, loading state, and active flag. Call this before targeting a specific tab.

activate_tab.description: Focus a browser tab by id so it becomes the active tab in the UI.

create_tab.description: Create a new browser tab and focus it. Optionally open a URL or search query in the new tab.

url.description: Optional URL or search query to open in the new tab

close_tab.description: Close a browser tab by id. Fails if it is the only remaining tab. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.

navigate.description: Navigate a browser tab to a URL or search query. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.

get_page_info.description: Get a tab's page title, URL, and loading state. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.

get_page_text.description: Get the visible text content of a tab's web page. Content may be truncated for very long pages. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.

get_page_selection.description: Get the text currently selected on a tab's web page, if any. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.

get_page_metadata.description: Get page metadata such as meta description, keywords, and Open Graph tags. Optional tab_id defaults to the active tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Defaults to the active tab.
